label: Music — Live Performance
description: A band or player mid-set, lit only by what the venue has. Stage light is coloured, hard and from above, and the whole point is that it is not flattering — so the frame keeps the haze, the backlight and the grain rather than cleaning them away.
prefix: A live music photograph, lit entirely by the venue. {ensemble}, playing ({instrument}:1.2), {expression}. {trigger}
suffix: Live Rendering: (stage light only — hard coloured keys from above, haze holding every beam:1.3), (caught between beats, nobody posing:1.2), (perfect hands on the instrument, detailed fingers:1.25), high ISO grain kept rather than cleaned, silhouettes allowed to go black, (sharp focal subject in a dark room:1.15).
negative: flat even lighting, studio backdrop, daylight, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused fingers, watermark, text, logo, child, chibi, underage
